name: Run Johnny RUNNNNN!!!
author: SurudoiRyu
description: The prototype of week 3 with everything in it (up to expert). Run away from the animals chasing you! Use space to jump (twice for double jump) dont fall into the water or hit a box. As you go and hold out longer, it will go faster but give you more points, post me your highscore and lets see who is able to get on position #1
